title: Characterize admissible primes for ordered shear factors (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with finite exact corroboration. The ordered rational matrix-shear factorization admits a prime q exactly when every northeast submatrix preserves its rational rank modulo q. The exact forbidden primes divide the product of the blocks' top determinantal divisors.

```text
for every northeast block B of A:
    require rank_Fq(B) == rank_Q(B)
then the rational ordered partial permutation lifts at every q-power width
```

Total rank alone is insufficient even for a determinant-one matrix. For both `[[1,N],[0,0]]` and `[[1,N],[0,1]]`, at a prime dividing N, the first width with no lower/partial-permutation/lower factorization is exactly `v_q(N)+1`, allowing any partial permutation at each width. Thus N=3 passes modulo 3 and fails modulo 9. This is an obstruction to that ordered route, not a lower bound for every implementation of the shear. No new kappa is claimed.

Only `research/ordered-shear-admissible-primes/` is added. The result was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit the retained manuscript and Grigor'ev's classical Bruhat decomposition for the ordered factorization and its cost use; Rohan Arun/PR39 and James Chang for rank-profile context; commdata2338/PR2160 for the unit-pivot local-ring branch and the residue-zero/higher-width distinction. Classical rank profiles and determinantal divisors are background. Predecessor results are cited, not audited or replayed.

## Evidence

- Before: the retained source gives a sufficient finite-factor-table prime choice. After: the new proof gives its intrinsic necessary and sufficient arithmetic criterion, preserving the independent odd-prime requirement.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized checks agree on 1,137 matrices, 5,685 matrix/prime pairs, 33,386 independently expanded minors, 897,148 finite-ring factor products and 62 explicit family memberships. Seven semantic and four invalid-input controls pass.
- Each registered command was timed locally, approximately 0.248 and 0.246 seconds. These are bounded replay measurements, not a speedup claim. Standard-library CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64.
- Registered package replay, committed bytes/modes/full-source-history preflight, official export integrity and normal/optimized read-only Git-free export replay pass. All eight exported files retain their hashes.

Exact reproduction commands from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ordered-shear-admissible-primes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -B research/ordered-shear-admissible-primes/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -O -B research/ordered-shear-admissible-primes/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/ordered-shear-admissible-primes --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another machine may substitute its CPython 3.12 path. The universal claim rests on `PROOF.md`; finite enumeration is corroboration. The direct checker emits a generated receipt bound to the six package-file hashes and writes no files. `SOURCES.json` pins the manuscript input and predecessor/procedure provenance at canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`.

## Limitations

No intrinsic bad-prime set for the actual enormous selected matrix list is computed. No actual selected prime, paid profile, physical implementation, native/ordinary tariff, precision/tape budget, supplier admission or selected frontier changes. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review or formal proof-kernel verification was run or claimed.

## Open next questions

- Compute the intrinsic bad-prime set for one source-bound structured compiler matrix list. Begin with its northeast determinantal ideals; the unexpanded list, symbolic minors and complete physical costs are blockers.
- At a bad prime, find a different physical route preserving the rank-priced shear tariff. Begin with N=3 over Z/9 and pay for every operation outside lower changes and a partial permutation. No such implementation is supplied here.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying this ordered-prime criterion or first failing width was found in the refreshed account list and exact northeast/matrix-shear searches. All account submissions opened since the advance CLAIM were screened by title and body. PR39 and PR2160 are merged predecessors with the distinct scopes credited above.

- [PR6198](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6198) proves four E8 span inputs in every odd characteristic using integer minors. It studies different matrices and span statements; this contribution characterizes the ordered lower/partial-permutation/lower route and its first failing prime-power width. No shared numerical value is computed here, and no extra computations were run to check that PR.

This is bounded overlap evidence, not a novelty guarantee.
